'''2012 Match Play Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 10–12 February 2012, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="forum">https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=669</ref> Xerox Day 1 and Day 2 sheets from the tournament-decklists PDFs are listed below as those scans are transcribed.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 10–12 February 2012
* '''Winner:''' —
